_meta.what_this_is: Per-request cost in dollars for 20 requests to an LLM API over one window. Sixteen are ordinary short requests costing a cent or a few; four are 'whales' -- long-context or high-output requests costing dollars. This is the shape almost every real cost, latency, and token-usage distribution takes: a dense pile of small values and a thin tail of huge ones. The tail is not noise to trim; it is where most of the money is.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored so the mean, median, tail share, and total are exact and checkable. No API, no billing export.
_meta.format: costs: list of per-request dollar amounts
